The programme

The AI x Talent Accelerator

Accelerate the adoption of AI by upgrading managers into leadapreneurs, mastering the Stratecution methodology, and measuring the valuation and ROI of every project created.

Running three seasons creates a self-sustaining culture of innovating with AI — and generates the data needed for objective, fair and effective succession planning.

Schedule a meet See the results

The standard

One deployed AI-enabled, KPI-aligned innovation project worth at least RM 40,000 — within 6 months.

Not a case study. Not a group exercise. A real project, validated in COSMOS by the participant's own manager.

01 · Upgrade people

Managers become leadapreneurs.

Upgrade managers into leadapreneurs with the CARES framework, and transform traditional talent into innovative leaders who build impactful solutions with AI.

A leadapreneur CARES about building a better organisation. Today's great leaders don't just manage — they are creative, adaptable and resilient experts in AI who deliver sustained impact.

02 · Execute process

Most organisations can strategise. Most can execute. Few can stratecute.

Stratecution is our proven 3-challenge methodology for AI innovation. Unlike traditional programmes built around group exercises and case studies, every leadapreneur applies Stratecution to individually create their own project.

Propose a strategy

Challenge 1 — AI x Design Thinking.

Build a prototype

Challenge 2 — AI x Lean Startup.

Deploy a solution

Challenge 3 — AI x Agile Execution.

Each challenge builds deeper capability and delivers measurable ROI. Progression is unlocked by securing growing levels of approval and support from seniors.

03 · Deliver projects

Every leadapreneur individually builds a real project.

A real AI innovation with a measurable valuation, digitally validated and verified in our platform COSMOS by the participant's direct manager.

04 · Create culture

The 5S Scoreboard

Culture is "the way we do things around here". It emerges from what an organisation recognises, rewards and ritualises. Five metrics. Five targets. One clear picture of where your culture stands and where it needs to go.

Moves the culture from learning theory to building solutions. We measure the number of AI innovation projects deployed in the last 12 months.

30%of total headcount — target

Moves the culture from bureaucratic pace to AI pace. We measure the average time taken to deploy an AI innovation project in the last 12 months.

6 monthsaverage to deploy — target

Moves the culture from innovation theatre to financial discipline. We measure the monetary value created by AI projects in the last 12 months.

10%of revenue — target

Moves the culture from pockets of innovation to mass participation. We measure the number of departments deploying an AI innovation project in the last 12 months.

100%of departments — target

Moves the culture from one-off programmes to embedded habit. We measure how many leaders return to coach and lead others in the next season.

50%return to coach — target
05 · Plan succession

The Greatness Grid

Traditional succession planning relies on manager opinions, performance reviews and subjective assessments of potential. Leadapreneur shifts that flawed model from subjective evaluations to objective valuations.

One simple principle: you earn your title by delivering value, not by being nominated for it. Three seasons, three levels of leadership. To graduate a level, a leadapreneur's project must meet the minimum valuation requirement — for example USD 10,000 for an AI Innovator.

AI Innovator

Season one. Deliver a project that clears the valuation bar.

AI Coach

Season two. Deliver again, and bring others with you.

AI Leader

Season three. Lead adoption at organisational scale.

Every step of the journey is earned, measurable and real.

06 · The Greatness Games

Turning AI adoption into serious fun.

The Greatness Games turn AI adoption from a dry training initiative into an elite-level challenge inspired by professional sport — a performance loop that drives the four outcomes every executive cares about.

Adoption

People step forward to join.

Rather than another mandatory workshop, the Games challenge people to prove what they can achieve in the age of AI.

Engagement

Participants build and experiment.

Serious fun creates a safe environment to explore AI tools and test ideas on real projects.

Outcomes

Real projects get delivered.

Every participant builds an AI-powered innovation that improves productivity, reduces cost or grows revenue.

Sustainability

Innovation becomes a habit.

Participants level up and return for the next season, gradually embedding innovation into the culture.

AI Marketplace for Wealth Trade Ideas

Solution. A centralised AI-powered marketplace that aggregates ideas across products, ranks them intelligently, and gives RMs side-by-side comparisons in a single view.

Direct-to-Consumer Commerce Hub

Problem. Heavy dependence on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok meant high marketplace fees, no pricing control and zero direct customer data.

AI-Powered Loan Assessment

Three-Week Process, Compressed to Two Days

Banking · Rebel Accelerator

Problem. A high-volume back-office process took three weeks end to end, bottlenecking downstream teams and burning skilled time on coordination.

Solution. An automation layer that orchestrates the workflow across legacy systems, eliminating handoffs and removing manual reconciliation.

Risk & Compliance · Pilot planned

AI Vision + QR Traceability for Quality Defects

Manufacturing · Accelerated Innovative Leadership Programme

Problem. Defects were caught too late. Manual inspection across high-volume lines meant defective tooling kept producing scrap until human eyes spotted it.

Solution. An AI vision camera flags defects on the line in real time, and a QR system traces every faulty product back to the tool that produced it — instant root cause, instant stop.

RM 24 millionSaved per production cycle

Built with: AI vision · QR traceability · Engineering + QA + Automation workflow

Risk & Compliance · MVP built

AI Early-Warning System for Credit Risk

Financial Services

Problem. Credit teams only saw loan trouble after repayments slipped — too late to coach borrowers, restructure, or protect portfolio quality.

Solution. An AI-driven early-warning engine that scores repayment behaviour, days-past-due trends and payment momentum, flagging at-risk loans weeks before default.

Weeks earlierDetection vs current process
BehaviouralRisk model trained on repayment data

About us

Welcome to Leadapreneur

Innovation is at the core of our mission, and we have honed the art of harnessing talent to create transformative breakthroughs for your organisation. With our proven approach, you can trust that your innovation initiatives will not merely succeed but will thrive, adding substantial value to your business.

Why we exist

We built Leadapreneur to future-proof your talent.

Leadapreneur is a future-proofing company. For 20 years, across 60,000+ professionals and $100M+ in measurable innovation ROI, we have done one thing: prepare talent for what's coming next.

Our answer to the AI challenge is the AI x Talent Accelerator — a 6-month programme where participants don't just learn about AI. They use it to individually propose, build and deploy real innovation projects with measurable business impact.

The standard we hold every participant to

One deployed AI-enabled, KPI-aligned innovation project worth at least RM 40,000 within 6 months.

We've done this with DBS, CIMB, OCBC, HSBC, AmBank, RHB, AXA, Axiata, Gamuda, Astro, Bursa Malaysia, Toshiba Malaysia, AMK and dozens more across banking, insurance, manufacturing, oil and gas, and GLCs across Southeast Asia.
